Quarterly revenue growth has accelerated over the last four quarters: +16% → +18% → +19% → +23% YoY.
Assets are 5.2× shareholders' equity (₹1.23 lakh cr); leverage is the business model for a lender, so watch asset quality rather than debt.
Gross NPA is 1.06% and net NPA 0.42% at the latest reported quarter.
Promoters hold 54.7%, unchanged over a year.
Foreign institutions hold 19.8%, −2.2 pp over a year.
Operating cash flow is not a useful quality test for a lender — deposits and loans flow through it. Judge earnings quality on asset quality and provisioning instead.

business.what: Bajaj Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) that provides a diversified range of lending products, including personal loans, MSME loans, rural lending, gold loans, and commercial lending, alongside deposit-taking and insurance distribution services to retail and corporate customers.
business.geography: The company operates extensively across India, with rural lending spanning 22 states and 2 union territories, and MSME lending present across 2,298 locations.

claims.claim: The company is seeing marginal moderation in NIMs due to the rising cost of funds environment.
claims.quote: You would see marginal moderation on NIM. As you move from here, we should be able to manage comfortably is what I would say

claims.claim: The company is raising capital primarily to support its growth story and maintain resilience.
claims.quote: The Board's decision of raising additional capital is principally driven by mainly growth story of India and of the company and its subsidiaries.

claims.claim: The company has stopped offering short-tenor gold loan schemes to avoid pushing customers into delinquency.
claims.quote: Since August stopped doing short-tenor schemes as a firm. We don't see any credit cost impact as a result of it

claims.claim: We added 5 million new customers.
claims.quote: we added 5 million new customers.

claims.claim: AUM growth was secular and broad-based.
claims.quote: AUM growth was secular and broad-based, as you can see from the composition summary later in the deck.

claims.claim: New labor code contributed to 10 basis points, INR60 crores.

claims.claim: Vintage performance continue to reflects, significant and sustained improvement and is now running below FY '20 our pre-COVID benchmark.

claims.claim: Digital platform is now contributing to 25% of the business for gold loan.
claims.quote: For gold loan, digital platform is now contributing to 25% of the business.

claims.claim: Gold loan portfolio grew by 115% and we foresee it to cross 5% of total AUM by FY27.

claims.claim: MSME growth was muted at 6% due to proactive risk actions taken since Q2 FY26.
claims.quote: MSME continue to see muted growth. It grew by 6% only on account of a set of proactive risk actions that we have been taking since Q2 FY'26.

claims.claim: The captive 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler business will wind down to less than INR 1,500 crores by September 2026.
claims.quote: This book will principally just wind down to less than INR 1,500- odd crores by September '26, it will lead to further improvement in GNPA and should result in lower credit cost for FY27.

claims.claim: The core performance of the company, eliminating one-time charges of new labor code and the accelerated ECL provision that we've taken in Q3 remained pretty strong.
claims.quote: the core performance of the company, eliminating one-time charges of new labor code and the accelerated ECL provision that we've taken in Q3 remained pretty strong.

claims.claim: The company has further strengthened its provisioning framework by implementing a minimum loss given default floor across all lines of our businesses.
claims.quote: the company has further strengthened its provisioning framework by implementing a minimum loss given default floor across all lines of our businesses.

claims.claim: Our overall market share across each one of these lines of businesses remain small.

claims.claim: The company is phasing out its captive 2-wheeler and 3-wheeler finance business.

claims.claim: The company has identified 123 high-impact areas for FinAI transformation, with 80 planned to go live by February 2026.
claims.quote: We have identified as a firm as part of our BPR process, 123 impact areas -- high-impact areas across business and functions with 80 of them, which will plan to go live by end of Feb '26.

claims.claim: The company has a 13% share of monthly loan volumes in India but only 4% of total balances.
claims.quote: We are 13% of number of loans in India on a monthly basis, but we are only 4% of the balances.

claims.claim: The company expects to reach a customer franchise of 120 million by the end of the year.
claims.quote: So and we can see a clear road map this year, we'll probably end at 120 million.
